description: Licensing Requirements: The Aimplan Data Input Table visual is free to download from Microsoft Marketplace. However, a paid Aimplan license and an active Aimplan instance are required to use the visual. The visual cannot be used without an Aimplan license. To purchase a license and obtain access to an Aimplan instance, contact Aimplan at https://www.aimplan.com. The visual provides an easy way to edit and work with data stored in the Aimplan Azure SaaS service or your Azure SQL databases. Replace home-grown solutions with spreadsheets on file servers or other non-scalable solutions. Design your own storage tables and connect this visual to the tables to enable users to edit data. Publish Power BI reports containing the Data Input Table to specific users to edit and maintain data, for example, account structures, product mappings, list of projects etc. Or capture transactional data such as daily time reporting, deliveries to the factory or KPI measures. Build small data ‘applications’ direct within Power BI, direct accessible in Power BI datasets or from other tools. Watch a demonstration of Data Management in Power BI! https://www.aimplan.com/lm/demo-data-input-table To learn more about Aimplan, visit www.aimplan.com or schedule a demo at https://www.aimplan.com/demo.
